I want to fix this together."* This models accountability and opens the door for repair. 2. **Work on a solution**: Propose a plan that respects both of your needs (e.g., trying lower-protein yogurt *together*, or adjusting meal prep to include their preferences). 3. **Reflect on the root issue**: Why does their yogurt bother you so much?
